opening.argument: The presentation is plainly structured as an official music performance, identified by the title “Monatik - Vitamin D (Official Video)” and supported by the song and performer credit, “Song: Monatik Dmitriy.” The visible scenes reinforce that purpose: a large group dances indoors, while other people gather around a small sailboat in the water. The description’s “Subscribe to the Monatik channel on YouTube:” is ordinary channel promotion, and “Do not be bored, get Vitamin D!” functions as entertainment-oriented song language. Nothing presented requires payment, private data, or financial participation, and no transaction or credential request is observed.
